title: Optimize Week — comms plan & CEO Q&A prep (scratch)
content:
Context:
- We want a short, low-friction internal comms plan to announce a 1-week companywide "Optimize Week" (perf tuning, batching experiments, model/quantization rollout tests, and a temporary feature freeze for non-critical UX changes). Objective: make sure engineers understand scope & priorities, give product/ops clear rollback rules, and arm CEO for 6-min town-hall blurb + 10-min Q&A.

High-level timeline (proposed):
- Mon Mar 17: announce + roadmap & team leads post kickoff notes
- Tue Mar 18: focused infra/serving experiments begin (A/B for KV caching, sampling batch sizes)
- Wed Mar 19: model/quantization validation + performance smoke tests
- Thu Mar 20: canary rollouts to staging + runbook rehearsals
- Fri Mar 21: results shareout, next-steps, open office hours

What this is (to be communicated):
- Short version: "Optimize Week is a focused company effort to reduce per-token cost and tail latency risk. We will pause non-critical UI features for the week so engineers can prioritize perf experiments and reliable rollouts."
- Key benefits to emphasize: lower unit cost, more predictable latencies, fewer surprises during holiday traffic spikes.
- Scope: backend inference, batching configs, caching, autoscaler policies, model quantization tests. NOT included: major product launches, marketing pushes, GA rollouts.

Owner model / points of contact (quick list for comms):
- Program lead: Anya P. (me) — coordinator, comms
- Infra lead: Jonas M. — autoscale, kernel selection tests
- Serving/runtime lead: Rowan L. — batching, KV cache tuning
- Product/UX liaison: Marta K. — determines what counts as "non-critical feature" and signs off on freezes
- SRE on-call: SRE rotation (tag: #sre-oncall) — rollback and incident triage

Logistics & channels:
- Announcement channel: #company-announce
- Triage & day-to-day discussion: #optimize-week (private initially, then open)
- Results shareout doc: Confluence page (CONFLUENCE-OPT-1234) with templates for experiment results
- Office hours: daily 45-min drop-ins at 4pm PT (calendar invites from Anya)

What to ask teams to do (short actionable bullets):
- Freeze non-essential UI and product changes for Mar 17–21 (product liaisons to flag exceptions)
- Run identified smoke tests before/after each experiment and post results to Confluence template
- Tag any experiments with JIRA-OPT-71 and link PRs (GH-PR-4200 style)
- If you need to ship a hotfix that touches serving, escalate to SRE and Infra lead

CEO talking points (6-minute blurb):
- 0:00–0:45: Opening — gratitude for rapid growth; small reminder that cost & latency directly impact product experience and long-term pricing freedom
- 0:45–2:00: Why now — models getting larger + more usage; we have clear levers (batching, caching, quant) that can materially change unit economics
- 2:00–3:30: What we’re doing — a focused, week-long effort where teams will prioritize experiments, validate canaries, and reduce rollout friction. This is not a product stunt, it’s investment in reliability and economics.
- 3:30–4:30: What to expect — limited UI changes, daily short syncs, open office hours. We’ll share metrics and decisions publicly at the end of the week.
- 4:30–6:00: Call to action & gratitude — encourage engineers to pair up across infra/product and celebrate top wins on Friday.

Anticipated tough questions + suggested answers (prep for CEO & execs):
1) Q: "Will this delay roadmap / customer commitments?"
   A: Short answer: no critical deliverables will be blocked. Product liaisons will approve exceptions. We built the week to reduce risk for high-impact launches later.
2) Q: "Are we going to roll back any models or change pricing?"
   A: No pricing changes planned. Model adjustments will be tested gradually — rollbacks are straightforward and SRE-led.
3) Q: "How will customers be affected?"
   A: Minimal. Hosted API will stay online; we will avoid any customer-facing experiments during peak windows and will use staging/canaries.
4) Q: "What if an experiment regresses quality?"
   A: Each experiment must include a quality gate (eval prompts + A/B) and a rollback plan. We will not promote changes that fail quality checks.
5) Q: "How do we measure success?"
   A: Primary metrics: token cost per request, p95/p99 tail latency, and failed-request rate. Secondary: successful canary rollouts and playbook completeness.
6) Q: "Will this be repeated?"
   A: Likely — we aim to run a cadence of focused optimization sprints if this week shows clear ROI.

Open questions I still need to resolve (notes to self):
- Confirm exact calendar dates with leadership (Mar 17–21 tentative)
- Get SRE head signoff on rollback SLAs and incident response expectations
- Finalize Confluence template for experiment results (linked to program page)
- Decide whether we allow limited customer-facing A/Bs for batching strategies (probably not)

Friday shareout template (to make results portable):
- Experiment name + owner
- Hypothesis (1 line)
- Setup (what changed: batch size, quant level)
- Key metrics before/after (tokens/cost, p95/p99 latency, quality delta)
- Decision (promote / iterate / abandon)
- Follow-ups (owners + due dates)

Quick comm examples (short messages we can paste into Slack):
- Announcement (public): "Heads-up: the company will run an internal Optimize Week Mar 17–21 to prioritize performance and cost experiments. Non-essential UI work should be paused; leads will post exceptions. Daily office hours at 4pm PT. Full details: CONFLUENCE-OPT-1234."
- Reminder (on Thursday): "Quick reminder: Optimize Week is ongoing. If you ran an experiment, please add results to CONFLUENCE-OPT-1234 and join 4pm office hours for triage. Thanks to all working on infra wins!"

Potential risks & mitigations (short):
- Risk: teams ignore freeze and create merge conflicts. Mitigation: product liaisons approve exceptions and small gating reviews on merges touching serving.
- Risk: experiment causes customer regression. Mitigation: canaries + quality gates + SRE rollback authority.
- Risk: low participation. Mitigation: exec visibility, small sub-incentives (internally recognized wins + team shoutouts).

Final checklist before announce (to-do):
- [ ] Get leadership greenlight on week dates
- [ ] Publish Confluence program page + templates
- [ ] Create #optimize-week Slack channel and calendar invites for office hours
- [ ] Draft & schedule #company-announce message and pinned FAQ
- [ ] Confirm SRE rollback playbook & on-call coverage
- [ ] Prep CEO 6-min script and share one-pager with execs

Random / scratch thoughts (short):
- Could ask infra to prepare a "one-click revert" button in staging for quick rollback demos
- Consider small bounty (swag + kudos) for measurable reductions > 10% in token-cost on a canonical workload
- Keep Friday shareout to 20 slides max — TL;DR must be first

Notes to self: keep this doc messy — will refine into clean announce + one-pager after leadership okays dates.
